C01_total_bdbr_vs_anchor.description: Full T-SCOPE achieves statistically significant negative Total BDBR vs unedited libx265 on Faster R-CNN AP@50.

C02_long_gop_p_frame_rate_reduction.description: Motion-compensated temporal pre-editing (wo_ctu_delta_qp) achieves lower P-frame BDBR than framewise spatial_only_scope on 32-frame GOPs.

C03_ctu_delta_qp_gain.description: Full T-SCOPE (with 16x16 QG quantOffsets + P-carry) lowers Total BDBR relative to pixel-only wo_ctu_delta_qp.

C04_real_codec_ste_gain.description: Hybrid real-codec STE training (full_tscope) lowers Total BDBR relative to proxy-only wo_x265_ste_proxy under identical hyperparameters.

C05_zero_shot_unseen_yolov8s_transfer.description: Single-teacher Faster R-CNN-trained T-SCOPE transfers zero-shot to unseen YOLOv8s with negative Total BDBR.
